note: MV2-12a active-career intake. Global annual recognition earned by players whose careers are IN PROGRESS (the career-stature archive's peak-year ceiling is 2022; these players are structurally absent from it). Every row is a citation-backed public fact established on or before the cutoff date: the player's display name as the canonical card carries it, their nation, the award year, a source-stated position, the specific distinction, and a fetchable public citation URL plus the claim it supports. NO rating numbers, rankings, OVR/channel/boost/override — only the recognition record. Each citation was fetched and confirmed to support its claim before commit. These rows are staged in the INERT active channel (source_facts_active.json); they never enter source_facts.json or career_stature.json until MV2-12b activates the channel.
curation_notes: Recognition that the pinned parser snapshots already carry for active players (e.g. annual-XI selections, century caps lists) is NOT re-asserted here — the build recovers those withheld parser records directly against the 2026 identity space, keeping snapshot provenance.

citation.claim: Lamine Yamal (Spain, Barcelona) won the 2024 Kopa Trophy.
Lamine Yamal won the 2025 Kopa Trophy, becoming the first player to win the award twice.
Lamine Yamal finished second in the 2025 Ballon d'Or ranking with 1,059 points, behind Ousmane Dembélé.
